The '''Enslavement of Kashyyyk''' was the protracted campaign in which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|subjugated]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and subsequently reclassified the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Wookiees became regular [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] prey for [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and were forced into conscripted labor on Imperial construction projects, including the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].
